howToPlay: Use invisibility to sneak behind enemies and surprise them with high damage at close range. Deploy the clone to confuse opponents or use the lollipop to create a hidden area for your team. Balance aggression with stealth to stay alive while landing effective strikes.
gears: Equip SPEED or DAMAGE to capitalize on his assassin role. Use LINGERING SMOKE or GADGET COOLDOWN to maximize his stealth and utility efficiency.
trait: This brawler suits a patient player who excels at maneuvering through shadows to execute precise ambushes.
